owner.name: cbs Corporate Business Solutions Unternehmensberatung GmbH

metadata.description: Agent skills and plugins from cbs Corporate Business Solutions.

plugins.name: cds-guard
plugins.description: Sets up @cbs-consulting/cds-guard in CAP and UI5 projects and keeps coding agents from changing protected CDS entities, annotations, code blocks and files by accident.

plugins.name: container-features
plugins.description: Sets up the cbs Dev Container Features in SAP BTP, CAP and Fiori projects: picks the Features a project needs, writes devcontainer.json and connects private npm feeds without committing tokens.

plugins.name: container-templates
plugins.description: Starts new SAP BTP projects from the cbs Dev Container Templates and helps when the container or the generator does not start.

plugins.name: generator-btp
plugins.description: Sets up SAP CAP projects with @cbs-consulting/generator-btp: asks what the project needs, runs the generator without interactive prompts, and walks through the next steps.

plugins.name: stack-sentinel
plugins.description: Sets up @cbs-consulting/stack-sentinel in SAP UI5, CAP and Node.js projects: the weekly scan pipeline on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Teams reports, fix pull requests and ignore rules.

plugins.name: virtual-key-mapper
plugins.description: Sets up vkm (Virtual Key Mapper): signs in to your company LLM gateway, connects Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other tools with short-lived keys, and assigns the labels that attribute each request to a repository.
